The investigation traced the flow of INR 4,70,000 originating from the seed wallet 0xa7f39c1d8e4b2a5f7c3d9e0a1b8c6d4e5f2a67e9 on 2026‑09‑08 at 10:31:04 +05:30. Fourteen distinct entities were identified across seventeen transfers, with a maximum depth of three hops. Sixteen transfers were confirmed and one inferred correlation was noted. The seed wallet carries a risk score of 65/100 (high), reflecting proximity to a known scam cluster, rapid automated dispersal within three minutes, interaction with a mixer contract (transfer of 1,500 USDT to 0x8589f2c47b1d0a63e95482f7ca1b3d6e0f4a0b6f), and exposure to a cross‑chain bridge within two downstream hops. Sixteen of the transfers meet or exceed the 30 % reporting threshold; one falls below it.

Among the entities, address 0x9c04a7e3b21d5f86c0a94e7d2b83f150c6ead21e received the highest risk score of 75/100 (critical), followed by the seed wallet at 65/100 (high) and address 0x3f1a7d92c04e8b56af10d3e7b829c45d6e0a71bc at 35/100 (medium). The pattern shows rapid, multi‑hop distribution involving mixing and bridging services.
